svg.title: Returns, customer credit, and refunds
svg.desc: Returns, customer credit, and refunds. Which records distinguish returned goods, credit, and cash paid back? Primary tables: SalesReturn, SalesReturnLine, CreditMemo, CreditMemoLine, CustomerRefund. A memo can reduce AR and retain excess customer credit. A refund is a separate optional cash event; do not infer one from a return.
